entities.name: 493-aa query protein
observations: Sequence-derived length 493 aa; estimated mass 52.24 kDa and pI 8.64.
Has Pfam matches YjeF_N (residues 1–177) and Carb_kinase (237–487).

Best-supported annotation is bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr: NAD(P)HX epimerase plus ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase; evidence is homology-based, not direct experimental validation.
Three reviewed Nnr homologs showed 31.9–32.7% identity and 95.1–98.8% query coverage. Homolog annotations include K+ as a cofactor.
